purpose: Blueprint-first furniture and museum prop production pipeline for web, future Electron, and the Human Protocol WebGPU runtime pack.

sourceResearch.title: GPT 驱动的 3D 家具资产与游戏道具生产方案研究报告
sourceResearch.absorbedPolicy: GPT/Image2 assist concept, specs, scripts, metadata, and QA. Blender/source geometry and repo manifests remain the production source of truth.

readinessPolicy.blueprint-ready: Specification is complete. Generated files may be pending.
readinessPolicy.source-ready: Image2 source art, Blender script, or source blend exists.
readinessPolicy.raw-ready: Raw GLB exists and still needs cooking/registration or visual acceptance.
readinessPolicy.runtime-ready: Cooked GLB, registry, builder catalog, thumbnail, and Raw WebGPU sidecar are present.
readinessPolicy.build-ready: Cooked GLB, registry, builder catalog, builder footprint, and thumbnail are present. Raw WebGPU sidecar is required only after official/build runtime baking promotes it to runtime-ready.

webDefault.transparentSurfaces: minimize overdraw; use glass edges and faint tint instead of large opaque panels

electronDefault.runtimePolicy: bundle cooked packs; preserve same manifest contract as web

pipelineStages.gate: source images are referenced or procedural-material-only is declared
report records scores, candidates, penalties, and chosen params when search is used
asset has grounded pivot, meter scale, bevels, weighted normals, and no visible proxy cubes
asset resolves by modelKey, not renderer hardcode
qa:visual-bake-contract and qa:builder:wgpu-assets pass when official/build content uses the asset

blueprints.role: Reusable museum glass display case seed asset for specimen and exhibit layouts.

materialSlots.name: base
materialSlots.intent: dark stone/metal plinth

materialSlots.name: trim
materialSlots.intent: old brass and smoked titanium

materialSlots.name: glass
materialSlots.intent: nearly transparent cyan-tinted case

materialSlots.name: emissive
materialSlots.intent: restrained cyan exhibit light

collisionProxy.notes: Case should block body movement but not cover nearby pickups.

lodPolicy.web: LOD0/1/2 or meshopt simplified cooked GLB
lodPolicy.electron: same modelKey with higher texture profile allowed later

integration.officialLevelPolicy: Reference by modelKey from LevelDefinition props or room kit only.
